Name: Dirt Path
Author: xyariaa
Description:
Do you want to add dirt patches onto your pretty all-grass farms? This mod is for you!
[left][/left]
[center][size=5]Features[/size][/center]
[left][/left]
[left][list]
[*]Dirt Path flooring, buyable at Robin's, craft using 2 stones[/*]
[*]Additional "flat-edged" path to surround full tiles – like my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51716]Grass Tiled Soil[/url] with config "dirt background"[/*]
[*]Recolor Support! Currently supports Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn, DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor, Xiddav's Dirt Recolor[/*]
[*]All three paths can be enabled and disabled, and you can chose a specific recolor → use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] for easier configuration[/*]
[*]/!\ You need to select the recolor from the main menu! It won't change if you're already loaded into the game [/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][center][size=5]Installation[/size][/center]
[list]
[*]Download the mod[/*]
[*]Extract the mod[/*]
[*]Place the mod in your Mods folder[/*]
[*]Don't forget requirements![/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][center][size=5]Notes[/size][/center]


Please report any bug you might find, including typos and mistakes in the text.[/left]
[left]See permissions for informations about translations.[/left]
